housing: Charleston's rentals range from historic single houses on the peninsula, many split into apartments, to apartment complexes and newer houses in West Ashley and on the islands.
climate: Look for water stains, damp and mold, and test the air conditioning; heavy rain, tidal flooding and hurricanes are common.
fact: Parts of the peninsula flood during heavy rain and king tides, so ask whether a unit or its parking has flooded before.
